replay_sampling: Uniform without replacement using a private CPU Torch generator
exploration: Caller-supplied epsilon; private Python RNG samples permitted actions only. Schedule must be frozen by a separate training protocol.
target: Double DQN: permitted online argmax, target-network value at that action. Terminal collection/collision/time-limit has no bootstrap.
future_reward_contract: Unchanged R2 reward:3*world_distance_progress-0.015+40*collection-30*collision-10*first_assistance. Truth is reward only, never actor input; bridge must verify this before training.
continuity: Consecutive original100ms records only. A new epoch is permitted as a next state only with cleared history/UNKNOWN previous request; it does not end physics or erase its reward.
checkpoint: CPU tensors, primitive dictionaries and RNG states only. Replay ring, online/target, Adam, private RNGs, counters and explicit between-episode cursor. weights_only=True; exact runtime/protocol/layout/recipe hashes required.
